roles.title: Software Engineer (Terminal & Infrastructure)

Role titles and hiring bar are not verified because bloomberg.com careers pages were bot-protected during research.

roles.title: Data Engineer / Enterprise Data
roles.notes: Inferred role family for a market-data and analytics company whose product is real-time financial data; Bloomberg's open-source releases (Comdb2 database, BlazingMQ messaging) signal the data-infrastructure domain. Not verified against a live posting.

roles.title: Infrastructure / Site Reliability Engineer
roles.notes: Inferred role family supported by Bloomberg's published messaging and C++ infrastructure stack (BlazingMQ, BDE, amqpprox) and its self-description centred on high-availability systems. Not verified against a live posting.

publishedExpectations.claim: Bloomberg's official engineering presence states: 'Bloomberg sits at the intersection of high-availability, low-latency, and large-scale computing. We have a long track record of contributing to open source software to build infrastructure and applications that address the unique technical constraints we face in the finance industry.'

The same official page invites engineers: 'Want to develop software for the world's most trusted information network for financial professionals? Check out our open roles', linking to the Bloomberg careers job search.

Bloomberg maintains official open-source projects that signal its engineering stack: BlazingMQ (message queue), BDE (C++ development environment libraries), Comdb2 (database), and memray (Python memory profiler) — evidence of heavy C++/Linux messaging-and-data infrastructure plus Python tooling.

Inferred: specific published requirements (languages named in postings, interview format, assessments) for Bloomberg technology roles could not be verified — bloomberg.com/careers and careers.bloomberg.com returned bot-challenge pages on 2026-11-09. The learner must consult the official careers page at https://www.bloomberg.com/careers/ (job search: https://careers.bloomberg.com/job/search/) for current role descriptions.

notes: Bloomberg is the sole market-data profile in the matrix. Official evidence captured on 2026-11-09 is limited to Bloomberg's GitHub engineering org (accessible), which frames the work as high-availability, low-latency, large-scale computing for financial data. All role titles, tracks and skill requirements for hiring are inferred from that stack signal; bloomberg.com careers surfaces (careers, /careers/technology, /professional) served bot-challenge pages to both plain HTTP fetches and a headless browser, so no job-posting text could be quoted. Treat interview formats and test names as unverified. Learners should consult the official careers page (https://www.bloomberg.com/careers/) and expect C++/Python, distributed systems and data-infrastructure emphasis to be the reasonable prep priorities for engineering seats.
